references.text: The same regulation regarding a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering for each lamb is found in the regular offerings on the new moon day.
A corresponding provision of a tenth of an ephah of flour per lamb applies to the seven lambs during the Feast of Unleavened Bread at Passover.
The same amount of grain offering per lamb for the seven lambs at the Feast of Weeks (Shavuot).
The same regulation concerning a tenth of an ephah of flour for each of the seven lambs at the Feast of Trumpets (Rosh Hashana).
The basic rule for a grain offering consisting of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour together with a lamb as a sacrifice.
The Day of Atonement (Yom Kippur), of which this offering in Numbers 29:10 is a part.
